integrated_answer.claim: GET and POST /api/v1/accounts/:account_id/conversations/:conversation_id/labels map to index/create; conversation labels expose only these two actions.

The conversation before_action resolves Current.account.conversations.find_by!(display_id: params[:conversation_id]), then invokes authorize @conversation, :show?. Account base includes EnsureCurrentAccountHelper and schedules current_account, conditional token API-access and MFA checks. This establishes visible call boundaries, not the omitted helper/policy's criteria.

Conversation-label parameters permit conversation_id and labels: []; model is @conversation. No catalog-membership restriction appears in this controller/concern; permissible values and normalization inside omitted persistence code remain unverified. GET reads model.label_list; POST calls update_labels(permitted_params[:labels]) then reads that list.

POST replaces the assigned label list rather than appending: update_labels calls update!(label_list: labels), while the distinct combining add_labels helper is not called by this endpoint. Persistence, normalization and edge-input behavior were not executed.
Both response templates emit json.payload @labels: the response has a payload wrapper containing model.label_list.

Account label CRUD is separate: /accounts/:account_id/labels exposes index/show/create/update/destroy for Current.account.labels, uses policy_scope/check_authorization, fetches by label ID, and requires nested label attributes title/description/color/show_on_sidebar. Destroy enqueues association cleanup. These are account label records, distinct from replacing a conversation's label list.

Supplied request-test source covers GET/POST unauthenticated unauthorized responses and successful authenticated account agents with inbox membership. GET checks label1/label2 substrings; POST seeds those then checks label3/label4 substrings. It asserts neither exact payload, old-label removal, reloaded persistence nor authenticated denial. This is coverage inspection, not passing execution.
